import 'dart:io';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart';
import 'package:fixture/src/luxo/client.dart';
import 'package:fixture/label.dart';
import 'package:fixture/identifier.dart';

class InspectTransport extends HttpTransport {
  final plans = <PreparedSelection?>[];
  InspectTransport(String endpoint, {http.Client? client})
    : super(endpoint, client: client);
  @override
  Future<T> call<T>(String api, {Map<String, dynamic>? params,
    GeneratedRequest? request, T Function(dynamic)? decoder}) {
    plans.add(request?.selectionPlan);
    return super.call<T>(api, params: params, request: request, decoder: decoder);
  }
}

Future<void> main(List<String> arguments) async {
  var calls = 0;
  Future<http.Response> handle(http.Request request) async {
    final expectedMask = calls++ < 2 ? 2 : 1;
    final expected = [1, 2, 1, expectedMask, 0];
    final actual = request.bodyBytes;
    if (actual.length != expected.length ||
        List.generate(expected.length, (i) => actual[i] == expected[i]).contains(false)) {
      throw StateError('request bytes: $actual');
    }
    final response = LuxoEncoder()..writeVarint(expectedMask == 2 ? 3 : 0);
    if (expectedMask == 2) {
      response.writeFieldString(2, 'Ada');
    } else {
      response.writeFieldInt(1, LuxoInt64.parse('9223372036854775807'));
    }
    response.writeEnd();
    return http.Response.bytes(response.bytes(), 200);
  }
  HttpServer? server;
  final InspectTransport transport;
  if (arguments.contains('--network')) {
    server = await HttpServer.bind(InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4, 0);
    server.listen((incoming) async {
      try {
        final request = http.Request(incoming.method, incoming.requestedUri)
          ..bodyBytes = await incoming.fold<List<int>>([], (bytes, chunk) => bytes..addAll(chunk));
        final response = await handle(request);
        incoming.response.statusCode = response.statusCode;
        incoming.response.add(response.bodyBytes);
      } catch (error) {
        incoming.response.statusCode = 500;
        incoming.response.write(error);
      } finally {
        await incoming.response.close();
      }
    });
    transport = InspectTransport('http://${server.address.host}:${server.port}/luvia');
  } else {
    transport = InspectTransport('https://example.test/luvia', client: MockClient(handle));
  }
  final client = LuxoClient(transport)..setMode(TransportMode.binary);
  try {
    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      if (await label(client) != 'Ada') throw StateError('label');
    }
    if (await identifier(client) != '9223372036854775807') throw StateError('id');
    final explicit = await client.getUser(select: 'id');
    if (explicit.id.value.toString() != '9223372036854775807') throw StateError('explicit');
    final plans = transport.plans;
    if (plans.length != 4 || plans[0] == null ||
        !identical(plans[0], plans[1]) || identical(plans[0], plans[2]) ||
        plans[2]?.text != 'id' || plans[3] != null) {
      throw StateError('call-site plan ownership');
    }
  } finally {
    client.close();
    await server?.close(force: true);
  }
}
